name: doordash_find_first_restaurant
intent: Find the first restaurant for a DoorDash search
description: Search DoorDash for a requested food or item, filter the results to restaurants, and report the name of the first restaurant shown.
patterns: search DoorDash and tell me the first restaurant
find the first restaurant for a DoorDash search
what is the first restaurant that comes up

inputs.name: search_query
inputs.description: The food or item to search for in DoorDash.

steps.intent: Tap Search DoorDash to open search
Type {{search_query}} in the Search DoorDash field
Tap Restaurant to filter the results to restaurants
